_comment: Pinned ASTAP command-line solver (astap_cli), fetched at build time by tools/fetch-astap and bundled into the Docker image and Windows installer. MPL-2.0, redistribution permitted. version is the ASTAP CLI release; sha256 is computed over the per-platform .zip. Bumped by .github/workflows/update-astap-cli.yml, which also mirrors the pinned zips to the astap-cli-VERSION prerelease on mirror_repo. That mirror is what makes a pinned build reproducible: SourceForge overwrites the version-less latest URL in place and keeps only one historical CLI snapshot in its older/ folder, so superseded pins vanish upstream. The mirror releases are public, so the fallback downloads them without credentials; with GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN set it also tries the API asset endpoint, which is how a private fork's mirror is read. Deleting a mirror release breaks every Commander release pinned to that version.
